add.title: A project folder inside a session (e.g. session-e00f55c9/sessions-and-tasks/) draws its task cards, not a file browser of its page.jsonl
add.why: Today the folder's page is Page.jsonl's file view, so the owner sees raw JSONL lines (review 7 of session-identity, finding 2; shot: sessions-and-tasks/session-identity/shots/…sessions-and-tasks/1200.png).

add.title: The session page takes 8-18 s to load
add.why: Measured 2026-11-06 on /framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/cloud-voice-app-20261106/ (9.4 s on the live site, 18 s in a worktree, headless at 1200 px); its streams answer after JSONL's 1.5 s wait (fixed in live-r17 so they still stream), but the owner waits that long to see the tasks.
